🎥🎬: The Mandalorian (2019–Present)

Din Djarin is a lone Mandalorian bounty hunter traveling through the galaxy after the fall of the Galactic Empire. During one of his missions, he is tasked with capturing a mysterious Force-sensitive child known as Grogu.

Instead of handing Grogu over, Din chooses to protect him, putting himself against the very people who hired him. Their journey takes them across dangerous worlds, where they encounter bounty hunters, Imperial remnants, rival Mandalorians, and powerful enemies.

As their bond grows, Din becomes more than Grogu’s protector. He begins helping reunite the child with his people while discovering more about his own Mandalorian identity and what it truly means to be a member of the creed.
